name: ship_date
description: Label ship/print date, normalized to YYYY-MM-DD from the source MM/DD/YYYY

name: tracking_number
description: Carrier tracking number - natural key. USPS 94.., UPS 1Z..

name: carrier
description: Carrier that moved the parcel: USPS or UPS. Stamps.com is the label vendor, not the carrier

name: service
description: Service level as printed, e.g. 'USPS Ground Advantage' or 'UPS Ground Saver'

name: weight_lb
description: Billed weight in pounds. Parsed from a decimal or an 'Xlb Yoz' string. Often blank in the consolidated export

name: amount_paid
description: Shipping cost paid for this label. CAN BE NEGATIVE - refunds and postage corrections post as negative rows

name: adjusted_amount
description: Post-audit adjusted amount when the carrier reweighed or rerated the parcel; null when never adjusted

name: order_id
description: Stamps.com Order ID. Join key to 3PL shipped-order reports; absent from the consolidated export

name: reference_1
description: Reference 1 field - usually the marketplace order or PO number. Join key for marketplace cost attribution

name: cost_code
description: Stamps.com cost code, used to tag the paying business unit or marketplace

name: to_name
description: Recipient name as printed on the label

name: to_zip
description: Recipient ZIP. STRING not INTEGER - leading zeros are significant

name: source_file
description: Originating Stamps.com PrintHistory CSV filename. The idempotency key: a reload of one file replaces exactly its own rows

name: ingested_by
description: gcloud account that ran the load
